title: The Daily Grind – Coconut Mocha 100ML
description:
The Daily Grind – Coconut Mocha 100ML
Get ahead of the daily grind with an invigorating selection of coffee house vape juice. Every bit as creamy and delicious as the real thing, these fresh cafe-style flavours are developed in the UK, produced in Australia.
The Daily Grind Coconut Mocha – An earthy and sweet coconut core, blended with smooth, rich chocolate, finished with a single shot of coffee
Primary Flavours
: Coconut, Chocolate, Coffee, Milk
PG/VG Ratio:
70 VG / 30 PG
Bottle Sizes:
100ml
Nicotine:
0 MG
